title: Source registry: every input the site can use, how it is obtained, when it goes stale and whether it may be shown publicly

sources.name: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (EUR/USD, EUR/INR)
sources.terms: Free use if reproduced accurately and the ECB is cited as the source; any modification must be stated explicitly. Rates are published for information purposes only.

publicDisplay.reason: ECB reuse policy permits reproduction with attribution; the USD/INR cross is labelled as derived.

sources.cadence: Each TARGET working day, around 16:00 CET/CEST. No rates on weekends or TARGET closing days (1 Jan, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, 25 and 26 Dec).
sources.observationTime: Daily concertation at about 14:15 Frankfurt time (Europe/Berlin).
sources.delay: Reference fixing, not a tradable quote. Published about 1 h 45 min after the concertation.
failureModes: Network or TLS failure: keep the last valid observation from the previous snapshot, marked STALE when overdue
Format change: parse fails, adapter records an error and keeps the last valid observation
TARGET holiday: no new row is expected and nothing is flagged
sources.retry: 3 attempts with 2 s, 6 s, 18 s backoff; 20 s timeout per attempt

sources.name: USD/INR reference derived from ECB rates (EUR/INR divided by EUR/USD)
sources.publisher: Derived by this site from ECB data
sources.role: Market FX leg of the benchmark conversion
sources.terms: Modification of ECB data, stated explicitly as required by the ECB reuse policy. Not an ECB publication of USD/INR and not an Indian official rate.

publicDisplay.reason: Derived from ECB data with the modification stated.

sources.delay: Reference fixing. FBIL's USD/INR reference (published by FBIL, shown on the RBI homepage) is the Indian benchmark but its reuse terms could not be read, so it is not used automatically.
failureModes: Missing EUR/USD or EUR/INR for a date: no cross is computed for that date (never interpolated)

sources.name: CBIC tariff values for gold and silver (Customs (N.T.) notifications under s.14(2))
sources.publisher: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
sources.role: Duty base (with the customs exchange rate)
sources.terms: Gazette matter: Copyright Act s.52(1)(q)(i) permits reproduction. CBIC permits linking but not framing (C-CBIC-TERMS).
sources.cadence: Regular notifications dated around the 15th and the last day of the month, in force the next day; ad hoc revisions on any day.
sources.observationTime: In force from 00:00 IST on the effective date.
sources.delay: Owner adds each notification to the registry. The site marks the value STALE once a scheduled revision date passes without a registry review.
failureModes: Owner misses a notification: value turns STALE after the next scheduled revision date
Document host unreachable: document hash check skipped and logged; values are unaffected

sources.name: Customs exchange rates for imports (ICEGATE Exchange Rate Automation Module)
sources.role: Converts the USD tariff value into rupees for the duty base. Distinct from market USD/INR.
sources.terms: Published on ICEGATE since 4 Jul 2024 (Circular 07/2024-Customs); no longer a Gazette notification, so s.52(1)(q)(i) may not cover it. Individual rates are used as facts with attribution.

publicDisplay.reason: A single official rate used as a fact with attribution; reuse terms of the ICEGATE viewer were not readable.

sources.cadence: Published at about 18:00 IST on the 1st and 3rd Thursday of each month; in force from 00:00 IST the next day.
sources.observationTime: In force from 00:00 IST on the effective date.
sources.delay: Owner copies the USD import rate each fortnight from ICEGATE's list of exchange-rate notifications (View Currency Exchange Rate > View Exchange Rate Notifications > Download PDF; no login or captcha). The date lookup on the same page needs a captcha and ICEGATE documents no data feed, so neither is automated. Rows from 19 Jun to 18 Sep 2026 were read from notifications 18/2026 to 27/2026 on 25 Sep 2026.
failureModes: No row for the current fortnight: duty legs are withheld (UNAVAILABLE), never back-filled from market USD/INR
Row older than 16 days past its window: UNAVAILABLE

sources.name: Dated duty rules and route executability flags
sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance (customs notifications) and DGFT
sources.role: BCD, AIDC and total rates by date and route; licence and quota conditions
sources.cadence: Changes with Budget and ad hoc notifications.
sources.delay: Owner updates when a notification is issued.
failureModes: Date outside documented coverage: PLACEHOLDER, never zero

sources.name: MCX contract specifications and expiry calendar
sources.publisher: Multi Commodity Exchange of India (read from copies and broker pages)
sources.role: Quotation unit, lot size, expiry, tender period

publicDisplay.reason: Contract terms are facts published by the exchange in circulars.

sources.cadence: Changes by MCX circular; new contract months launch monthly.
failureModes: Contract month not listed: expiry computed from the rule and marked PROBABLE (holidays not loaded)

sources.name: MCX daily closing or settlement prices (bhavcopy)
sources.role: Futures quote for basis and spreads
sources.status: BLOCKED FOR PUBLIC DISPLAY (display rights not confirmed)
sources.terms: mcxindia.com blocks automated access; its terms of use and data-redistribution policy could not be read. No automated retrieval is attempted.

publicDisplay.reason: Redistribution rights not confirmed. Prices you add are processed but kept out of the public snapshot until this switch is changed.

sources.cadence: Each MCX trading day after the evening session (trading runs to 23:30 or 23:55 IST).
sources.observationTime: Close of the trading day, IST.
sources.delay: Manual. A visitor may load a bhavcopy they downloaded themselves; it is parsed in their browser and never uploaded.
failureModes: Column names changed: file rejected with the list of missing columns
Contract not in the registry: comparison withheld

sources.name: COMEX gold (GC) and silver (SI) futures settlement by contract month
sources.terms: CME permits personal non-commercial use only and prohibits public display and automated retrieval without a licence. Public website display needs a CME licence (fee list: 'Public Website USD 487', Delayed and Historical only; billing period not confirmed).

publicDisplay.reason: No CME licence. The public site shows the benchmark as UNAVAILABLE unless a visitor enters one in their own browser.

sources.cadence: Daily settlement each CME business day (around 13:30 New York time for gold and silver).
sources.delay: Not connected. A licensed delayed feed (for example Databento Plus with a CME licence) is the documented upgrade path.
failureModes: Generic spot quote entered: labelled as a generic benchmark, never as a COMEX contract

sources.name: Local cost and financing assumptions (freight and insurance, assay/refining, handling, financing rate and days, physical premium)
sources.status: NOT SUPPLIED (owner has not set defaults)
failureModes: Not supplied: landed values are shown before local costs, labelled as such

sources.name: Values entered by the visitor in this browser
sources.terms: Stored only in this browser. The page's Content Security Policy blocks all network requests, so nothing is sent anywhere.
failureModes: Invalid entry: rejected and dependent outputs withheld

sources.name: Zerodha Kite Connect (optional, later)
sources.role: Authorised MCX quotes for the owner's private use
sources.terms: Rs 500 per month per API key (the free Personal plan has no market data). Terms s.2(a): live market data cannot be displayed to the public at large. Access token expires at 6 AM each day and login must be manual.

publicDisplay.reason: Kite terms forbid public display, so Kite can only ever feed a private owner view.

failureModes: Token expired at 6 AM: owner must log in again
Market closed: last tick kept as STALE

sources.name: Synthetic demonstration data
sources.terms: Invented round numbers. Never shown outside demo mode.

publicDisplay.reason: Labelled SYNTHETIC on every card, chart and export.

sources.observationTime: None: synthetic data has no market time.
